thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P1 runtime OOM on prod-cluster-5 > high error rate for /v1/generate. Auto-inc created 3452109877
raj: I'm on it, grabbing logs and node list. Any customer impact yet?
maria: Seeing 502 spikes in the dashboard, tx success down ~12% for the last 3m. Customer-support: A couple of enterprise customers reported errors, CS triaging.
jess: Can you paste the pod/node memory stats? suspect KV cache thrash.
raj: pulling node stats -> `kubectl top nodes --selector=cluster=prod-cluster-5`
raj: attaching quick snapshot:
```
NODE            CPU(%)   MEM(%)
gpu-node-12     58%      92%
gpu-node-14     60%      95%
```
eli: GPU memory high + fragmentation hints. On the runtime side we saw repeated allocation failures at ~80% utilization.
ops-oncall: rolling paging mitigation to affected pool: scale down batch size for canary and trigger kvcache eviction. Will coordinate.
raj: timeline so far:
- 3452109800: small latency bump (ignored)
- 3452109877: pager fired, error rate jump
- 3452109930: first customer reports
- 3452110005: started scaledown of canary batch size from 8->4
- 3452110100: applied kvcache eviction policy change (LRU threshold -> 60%)
- 3452110160: errors start to decline but still noisy

maria: sharing logs snippet from runtime (allocation failures):
```
2026-03-17T12:04:37Z runtime ERROR allocation failed: requested=512MB available=120MB
2026-03-17T12:04:37Z runtime WARN fragment: free_chunks=3 largest=64MB
```

jess: hypothesis: KV cache growth + long-lived prefixes leading to fragmentation. Also batch size=8 increases transient KV allocations per request. Two levers: reduce batch, trigger KV eviction, force small defrag window.
eli: +1. Also noticed model kv cache hits dropped ~15% (suggests churn). Evidence: embed-kv hit-rate time series: `hit_rate: 0.68 -> 0.54` coincident with error spike.
ops-oncall: live mitigations applied:
- batch size override route /v1/generate -> 4 for prod-cluster-5
- kvcache eviction aggressive for affected GPUs
- temporarily route heavy customers to dedicated spare pool (if they accept slight latency)

customer-support: notified affected customers and offered reroute; one enterprise accepted reroute and saw success.
raj: sharing more logs from GPU allocator and kernel:
```
[12:05:01] allocator: free_list_frag=0.22, pages_in_use=0.87, evictions=120
[12:05:10] kernel: mmap failed fallback->paging, latency spike
```

jess: can we capture memory heap map and run small defrag? I want the allocator stats at 3452110200.
eli: running `runtime-admin snapshot-alloc --node gpu-node-14 --out /tmp/snap-3452110200` now. Will paste results when ready.

alice: quick note: reduced batch immediately dropped 502s by ~60% on canary. Good signal that batch-related allocation concurrency was amplifying frag.
maria: for RCA we should track: KV cache size over time, per-request allocation peaks, and batch concurrency. Also add customer impact window.
raj: agreed. I'm compiling timeline + logs and will upload to the incident doc. Next steps for post-incident:
- Full allocator trace capture from affected nodes (already started)
- Reproduce locally with synthetic workload that increases prefix caching
- Evaluate permanent change: default batch-size policy + auto-eviction heuristics
- Engineering follow-up: consider slab allocator tuning or compact-on-evict flag

ops-oncall: handing off to oncall for postmortem work, I'll keep monitoring. @raj you're owner for RCA writeup.
raj: taking owner. ETA for initial RCA draft: 2h. I'll call if we need escalations. :thumbsup:
